assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Input1 EDIT TARGET existing Yeoul sprite: preserve its exact pose, gesture, emotion, props, costume, hairstyle, tail, canvas and crop. Input2 and Input3 are USER-APPROVED final illustration/color/eye references (R03 and R04). Input4 is the canonical fullbody model/line reference. Apply the approved rich angular cel-painted style, not the old target's detailed iris/soft rendering. A human-faced flying-squirrel girl with angular white hair buns, huge pink bow, rose eyes, pink-white dress, mint-striped white socks and large fluffy white tail. Keep human face/nose/mouth/skin/hands; no muzzle/paws.
Very thick crisp almost-black NAVY outer contours with thinner simpler facial/clothing lines, long straight segments, wedges/trapezoids/sharp directional bends in hair/jaw/elbows/knees/collars/hems. Appealing Japanese anime face plus the bold anatomical exaggeration and graphic TV-cartoon sensibility of Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt. Same underlying3.5–4human-head model excluding ears/hair/bow: large head, short compact torso, long slender forearms/shins, narrow wrists/ankles, oversized expressive hands and geometric thick-soled footwear. Seated/bent/cropped views keep same underlying limb/head relationship, never2-head toddler or realistic adult fashion proportions.
Retain vivid rich PINK/ROSE/MINT colors and ivory white. Broad clean flat BASE plus ONE clear hard-edged polygon CEL SHADOW per material, optional tiny third step only where needed. Whitehair/clothes/tail/shoes ivory+restrained lavender; pink+deeperrose; skin warmpeach+restrained warmviolet. Shadows large triangle/trapezoid planes, NOT tiny disconnected facets on every fold and NOT giant muddy face patches. Keep garment's intrinsic stripes/panels. No desaturation or unshaded coloringbook look. No gradients, airbrush, bloom/soft glow, glossy volumetric skin, grain/texture, painterly brushwork or3D.
EYES consistently match Yeoul in approved R03: rose almond geometry, heavy dark upperlid and pointed outerlash wedges, slightly upturned outercorner, same face-relative size and spacing. Simple iris/pupil and ONE crisp white glint per open eye; avoid intricate iris bands/rings/excess sparkle. Emotion changes lids/brows/gaze/mouth, not the eye identity. Fear opens the same almond eyes, not huge round doll eyes. Retain naturallyclosed eyes when expression requires them.
GENUINE TRANSPARENT alpha0 surround and holes. No background, checkerboard, opaque backdrop, groundshadow or halo. All existing bow/ears/tail/fingers/shoes must fit within canvas with clear margins. No new costume ornaments or symbols, no text/UI/logo/watermark. Keep original source canvas aspect and framing. ONE sprite only.

assets.prompt:
EDIT the first image into ONE transparent WAIST-UP dialogue sprite. Make a clearly visible correction to the FACE so this character looks youthful and lively like the SAME character in image2. Image1 supplies the EXACT existing pose/gesture, costume and hair; image2 supplies the youthful face proportions. Images3–4 are the user's approved bold anime/Western TV cartoon art style. Keep the entire silhouette composition and hand positions from image1.

REBUILD THE FACE, do not retain its mature face geometry: shorten the nose-to-chin/lower-face distance by about 15%, keep a small simple angular chin, light warm peach skin (#FFE7D2) as one large clean flat color across BOTH cheeks and around BOTH eyes. Lift and OPEN the almond eye aperture about 25% vertically with the same slightly upturned outer corners and very thick navy wedge upper lashes. Keep iris colors and a single little white glint. Eliminate the peach-pink duplicate eyelid stripes above the upper lashes, dark skin surrounding the eyes, lower-eye folds, cheek creases, hollow cheeks, long narrow adult jaw and huge dark split-face patch. Use one simple thin eyebrow per side. Convey each expression with eyebrows and mouth. It must look like the lively youthful cartoon cast in image2, not a tired mature adult; do not turn into a baby/chibi.

Strict art direction: strong graphic sensibility of Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt; Japanese anime facial appeal, bold angular nearly-black NAVY exterior contours, thinner simplified internal marks, angular wedge hair clumps and collars, compressed torso with long slender forearms and oversized expressive HUMAN hands. Preserve the original underlying3.5–4-head cartoon body even though cropped waist-up. Vivid FLAT base colors; one small, crisp hard-edged cel-shadow shape per material where needed. Mostly bright white/ivory on white fabric/hair with sparse light-lavender shadow polygons, vivid orange/gold or cyan/blue or pink/rose as original. Leave 95% of the visible face in the clean light base color, with only a tiny shadow below fringe/chin. Broad flat colors, no gradients, grain, airbrush, texture, glossy3D, glow or dense shadow facets. Keep clothing/accessory designs unchanged.

Output isolated character on TRUE alpha0 TRANSPARENCY, including gaps around hands/arms; no painted dark background, checkerboard, vignette, halo, backdrop, floor or table. Waist crop only, no legs. Leave clear transparent margins around COMPLETE ears, hair, ribbons and hands. No text, new props, additional characters or contact sheet.
CHARACTER: white-haired human-faced flying-squirrel girl, rose-pink eyes, angular white twin side buns and long angular ribbon-like side locks, white animal ears with pink inner planes, huge pink head bow, white collared blouse and white sleeves with broad pink-white striped cuffs, pink neck bow and pink-white dress.
POSE AND EXPRESSION: confident reserved small closed-mouth smile and arms crossed in front of body, both hands visible.
Asset R01_YEO_01.
ANATOMY CHECK: Every HUMAN hand has exactly FIVE digits total: four fingers plus one opposable thumb, never six. Preserve pose/gesture and natural overlap. A palm-out spread hand must have only five distinct fingertips.
assets.review: Viewed final source: bright clean face base, more open almond eyes, youthful short lower face, thick angular navy outline and vivid flat/cel colors; distinct original gesture/expression retained.
